These are the interactive Julia scripts we build during class. Download a file,
open it in VS Code (or your editor of choice), and run it alongside the lecture.

| Lecture | Topic | File |
|---------|-------|------|
| 1 | Intro to Computation and Basic Julia | [CodeAlong1.jl](codealongs/CodeAlong1.jl) |
| 2 | Performance Optimization and Advanced Julia | [CodeAlong2.jl](codealongs/CodeAlong2.jl) |
| 3 | Numerical Optimization and Root Finding | [CodeAlong3.jl](codealongs/CodeAlong3.jl) |
| 4 | Interpolation and Integration | [CodeAlong4.jl](codealongs/CodeAlong4.jl) |
| 5 | Parallelization and UW Resources | [CodeAlong5.jl](codealongs/CodeAlong5.jl) |
| 6 | Dynamic Programming | [CodeAlong6.jl](codealongs/CodeAlong6.jl) |
| 7 | Distributions, Equilibrium, and AI Tools | [CodeAlong7.jl](codealongs/CodeAlong7.jl) |
| 8 | Estimation | [CodeAlong8.jl](codealongs/CodeAlong8.jl) |

: Code-along files {.striped .hover}

::: {.callout-tip}
CodeAlong8 reads a dataset: download [wages.csv](codealongs/data/wages.csv) into a
`data/` folder next to the script (or alongside it — the script looks in both).
[make_wages.jl](codealongs/data/make_wages.jl) is the seeded script that generated it.
:::
